items.title: Configurable inactivity timeout for console
items.summary: Full-access administrators can now configure the duration of inactivity on the Citrix Cloud console before administrators are automatically signed out. The configurable inactivity timeout ranges from 10 minutes to 12 hours, with a default of 60 minutes. For more information, see System and Connectivity Requirements .

items.title: Conditional Authentication enhancements
items.summary: Conditional Authentication now supports additional identity providers and policy conditions. For more information, see Conditional Authentication .

items.title: SAML using Entra ID for Guest and B2B identities
items.summary: Citrix Cloud now supports store authentication for guest and B2B user identities using Entra ID as a SAML provider. For more information, see SAML using Entra ID for Guest and B2B identities for store authentication .
